Hildegard 0.1.7 is a pre-alpha. It makes products: parts you can 3D print that fit the first time, and websites that
are checked at every width before they ship.

## Install

- **macOS and Linux:** `curl -fsSL https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.sh | sh`
- **Windows (PowerShell):** `irm https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.ps1 | iex`
- **Desktop app:** pick your system's download below, or from [dbaney.com/hildegard](https://dbaney.com/hildegard/).

Installed already? Hildegard updates itself, or run `hildegard update`.

## New

- **Parts to print.** The new **hildegard-print** skill takes a part from a brief, a photo of the old one or a shop
  listing to a print sheet. `print_kit.py` measures photos against a card, a coin or a sheet of paper, straightens
  photos taken at an angle, and keeps the source and tolerance of every dimension. Each round, Hildegard measures the
  gap between parts against your printer's clearance for each fit, catches parts that overlap, lays the model over
  the photo's outline, and slices it: time, grams and filament cost, against the price of buying the part.
  [docs/make.md](https://github.com/baney75/hildegard/blob/main/docs/make.md).
- **Your printer.** `printer_profile` keeps your printer's bed, nozzle, filament and price, and the clearances a fit
  coupon calibrates. PrusaSlicer is found and used with no setup; OrcaSlicer and Bambu Studio take your exported
  profiles.
- **The print sheet.** `loop_finish` on a print loop writes one page to print or hand on: the part from every side,
  what it takes and saves, how the parts fit, every dimension and its source, and what to check first. Beside it, an
  STL per part in its print pose, and the G-code.
- **Websites.** The new **hildegard-web** skill and a `web` loop: Hildegard opens every page in a browser cut off from
  the network, at phone, tablet and desktop width, in light and dark, outlines every problem, and checks contrast,
  sideways scrolling, alt text, names and labels, tap targets, type, headings, stand-in and stock copy, weight,
  offline loading, dark mode, reduced motion and focus. Send a page, a folder or a ZIP.
- **`hildegard loop run`** takes `--kind web`, and a print run reads the printer and the measuring kit.

The print workflow follows [print3d](https://github.com/mfranzon/print3d) by mfranzon (MIT).

## Known limits

- The web loop needs Chrome, Chromium or Edge on the computer Hildegard runs on.
- Slicing needs PrusaSlicer, or OrcaSlicer or Bambu Studio with your printer's exported profiles. Without one, rounds
  are checked but not sliced.
- Macs don't render on their own GPU yet. Pair a Mac with a computer that has an NVIDIA or AMD GPU
  (`hildegard choir join`).
- The Windows and macOS apps aren't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper ask you to confirm
  the first launch.
- claude.ai, ChatGPT, Grok and Grok Bot reach Hildegard only at a public link (`hildegard host --funnel`). Hildegard
  Link, the encrypted relay that needs no Tailscale, is coming soon.
- LTX models follow Lightricks' license: free under $10M yearly revenue, and not for products that compete with
  Lightricks. Wan 2.2 is Apache-2.0.
